ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Which of the below is a producer?
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a marine food web diagram, and the organisms labeled in the diagram include dolphin, seal, seagull, starfish, herring, mussel, crab, limpet, plankton, algae and seaweed. The question asks "Which organism is a producer?" Reasoning: Producers are organisms that can make their own food, usually through photosynthesis; animals such as fish, crabs, seagulls, seals, dolphins, etc. are consumers. The labeled organism in the diagram that fits the characteristics of a producer is seaweed. Therefore the answer is Seaweed.
